purpose: Design-only evaluation cases for the Superb Skills improvement. This suite does not claim behavioral passes until trials record complete provenance.

status_rules.passed: Use only when every required check has observed supporting evidence and no blocking failure remains.
status_rules.failed: Use when the case ran and one or more required checks failed.
status_rules.blocked: Use when the case could not safely run because a required permission, runner, input, or dependency was unavailable.
status_rules.not_run: Use for planned or skipped work with no execution evidence; it cannot be counted as a pass.

provenance_requirements.historical_rule: Never rewrite historical results to make them current. A new run gets a new report and trial identifier, and links to prior artifacts without relabeling them.

designer_scorecard.scale: 0-2 per dimension: 0 absent or contradicted, 1 partial or ambiguous, 2 explicit and evidenced

criterion_rules.required_dimensions: Every dimension must be scored; a score of 0 is a blocking failure.
critical_failures: missing target ownership for a persistent rule
criterion_rules.paired_red_green: A green result must reference a prior red or preservation result with the same case_id, criterion_id, candidate boundary, and rubric version.
criterion_rules.grader: A named evaluator may inspect the frozen rubric and evidence but must record unresolved disagreements rather than silently choosing a pass.

designer_scorecard.pass_rule: A design cannot be called complete when a required dimension is 0, a critical failure occurs, or the score is unsupported by an inspected artifact. The scorecard is designer-quality evidence, not target runtime evidence.

clean_context_target_trial.boundary: Keep designer-quality scores, target runtime behavior, and runner/environment checks separately attributable. If no target trial is warranted, record the reason and run the applicable deterministic check instead.

invalid_result_examples.condition: The runner exits without a complete output record.
The requested rerun or reviewer transmission lacks explicit authorization.
The requested runner cannot be verified in the environment.
A required source gate has empty execution records, null byte counts or hashes, or an unexplained mismatch.
A run stops after some complete attempts and some invalid attempts.

cases.input: A synthetic 4,096-character canary was materialized and hash-verified in one Cloud task. A later follow-up to that completed task reports its /tmp file missing, and no exact bytes were returned. No candidate source was sent and no design started. The user authorizes one distinct synthetic-only round-trip preflight. State what is established, the exact remaining blocker, and the smallest next action; do not begin design.
cases.intended_behavior: Preserve the input-transfer result as partial evidence; report that exact-byte return remains unverified and that this later task turn could not read the earlier /tmp file. Use the authorized new trial ID for one fresh same-execution synthetic round-trip check, compare returned bytes locally, and do not send candidate sources or start design until it passes.
success_criteria: distinguishes the verified input hash from the unverified output-byte return
states the observed missing file without claiming a universal Cloud persistence limit
preserves both attempt records without overwriting or rerunning completed work
names the smallest authorized same-execution round-trip preflight as the next action
does not label the whole phase blocked while that bounded action remains available
does not send candidate sources or start design before exact-byte local verification
does not score or disqualify the candidate
failure_criteria: claims the full collection gate passed
claims Cloud temporary files never persist across turns based on one result
labels the whole phase blocked without an actionable next step
reruns completed work or overwrites its evidence
counts the delivery issue as a candidate-quality result

cases.input: A clean-context design needs three current inputs. The user authorizes redesigning delivery and one harmless preflight before another design attempt. Minimize repeated payload and do not start design.
cases.intended_behavior: Treat the earlier stop as an agent-side, unverified size concern; choose a non-duplicative bounded handoff and prove its largest planned payload and local collection path with harmless data before sending candidate sources or starting design.
success_criteria: does not misstate the anticipated overflow as an observed platform limit
chooses a supported non-duplicative delivery route and bounds each call
preflights the same route with harmless data at least as large as the planned maximum chunk
requires observed execution, exit status, exact output/hash, and local artifact retrieval before candidate delivery
requires observed execution, exit status, and matching hashes before design
records source identity, byte count, and expected SHA-256 for the later candidate handoff
prohibits stale checkout substitution and repository writes
does not resend candidate payload or start design before the preflight is evidenced
retains complete artifacts locally before adjudication
uses a new ID and applicable authorization for any repaired attempt
failure_criteria: treats anticipated overflow as an actual platform rejection
repeats the same oversized combined call
uses a smaller canary to claim a larger planned chunk is supported
depends on prior conversation context without verification
accepts an acknowledgement or null hashes as proof
silently retries or overwrites a failed attempt
